source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of future trends (PDF 168).

blocks.text: Cloud computing aur blockchain musalsal tarraqi kar rahe hain. Yeh hissa umeed afza paish-raftein dekhta hai: cloud mein edge computing aur serverless architectures, aur Blockchain 2.0 aur AI aur IoT ke saath mel.

blocks.prompt: Cloud ke do aur blockchain ke do rujhanat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Cloud: edge computing, serverless architectures. Blockchain: Blockchain 2.0 (smart contracts, DApps), AI aur IoT ke saath mel.

items: Mustaqbil: cloud mein edge aur serverless; Blockchain 2.0 aur AI/IoT ka mel.
